question: Who among the following Tennis players won the Laureus World Sportsman of the Year Award 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rafael Nadal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​​Rafael Nadal** is a Spanish tennis player.
 
• **He won the Laureus World Sportsman of the Year Award 2021.**
 
• He is currently ranked world No. 3 in singles by the Association of Tennis Professionals.
 
• He has been ranked world No. 1 for 209 weeks.​ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Mohamed Salah is an Egyptian footballer.
 
• Billie Jean King is an American former world No. 1 tennis player.
 
• Max Parrot is a Canadian snowboarder.
